about: BIT Baroda is an IT and professional certification training institute in Vadodara, Gujarat, established in 2002. Over 23 years of experience, IBM and IIT Patna certified programs, ISO 9001:2015 certified, with 25,000+ students placed in top MNCs. Offers online and in-person courses with internships and placement support.

general_faqs.question: How do I enroll in a course?
general_faqs.answer: Enrolling is simple. You can fill the inquiry form on our website, call us on +91 9328994901, or visit our Vadodara campus. Our counsellors will guide you through course selection and the enrollment process.

general_faqs.question: Do you offer online courses?
general_faqs.answer: Yes, we offer both online and in-person classroom courses. You can choose the format that suits your schedule and learning style. Recorded lectures are also available for enrolled students to review at their convenience.

general_faqs.question: Do you provide placement assistance?
general_faqs.answer: Yes, our programs are job-oriented with placement support. We have placed over 25,000 students in top MNCs like TCS, Infosys, Capgemini, and Wipro. We also offer internships and real-world project training.

general_faqs.question: Are there EMI or installment options for fees?
general_faqs.answer: Yes, we offer course fee installment and EMI options for many of our programs to make them affordable. Please speak to our counsellors for the specific plan for your chosen course.

general_faqs.question: Are the certifications recognized?
general_faqs.answer: Yes. BIT is ISO 9001:2015 certified, and many programs carry certifications from IBM and IIT Patna. We also offer government-recognized NIELIT courses. These certifications give you an advantage in the job market.

general_faqs.question: Do you offer internships?
general_faqs.answer: Yes, we offer internship opportunities, co-op programs, and practical project training in many courses, so you can apply your skills in real-world settings and gain industry experience.

general_faqs.question: What are your timings and location?
general_faqs.answer: We are located in Sayajigunj, Vadodara. Our hours are Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 6 pm, and we are closed on Sundays. We have multiple branches across Gujarat.

general_faqs.question: Do I need prior experience to join?
general_faqs.answer: It depends on the course. Many foundational courses like Python, Spoken English, and Tally are open to everyone with no prior experience. Advanced courses like Machine Learning may recommend basic background knowledge. Our counsellors can suggest the right starting point for you.

general_faqs.question: Do you have weekend batches?
general_faqs.answer: Yes, most of our courses offer both weekday and weekend batches so working professionals and students can choose timings that fit their schedule.

general_faqs.question: Will I get a certificate after completing the course?
general_faqs.answer: Yes, you receive a certificate on course completion. Depending on the program, this may be a BIT certificate, an IBM or IIT Patna certification, or a government-recognized NIELIT certificate.
